target.statement: Faster R-CNN + APDI + Box IoU head with ResNet-50 FPN, 1x schedule, achieves 42.0 AP on COCO test-dev (vs 38.3 AP for reimplemented Faster R-CNN baseline)

compute.basis: The paper's own implementation details state all experiments ran on 8 Tesla V100-16GB GPUs; a 1x COCO training schedule is ~90k iterations of Faster R-CNN with ResNet-50 FPN, which is many GPU-hours even on a single V100 and infeasible on an 8-core CPU laptop within a few hours.

blockers: No code released: the paper only links to the generic detectron2 repo, not to APDI/Box IoU head implementations; the APDI training loop and Box IoU head would have to be re-implemented from scratch.
Training requires GPU: the paper used 8x V100-16GB; a 1x COCO schedule on CPU is not feasible in a few hours.
COCO train-2017 (~18 GB) plus test-dev must be downloaded and preprocessed.
The headline number is on test-dev, which requires submitting to the COCO evaluation server (or at least running full inference on 20k test images).
title: Augmenting Proposals by the Detector Itself
